## Done when

Scoped SDLC tasks create sparse worktrees hydrating only target paths; an out-of-scope write auto-widens (git sparse-checkout add) without failing; phase-READY worktree creation batches through a bounded (cpu_count, ceil 4) thread pool; a reuse pool resets surviving worktrees (checkout -B + clean -fd) between phases and tears down to remove+add on any reset failure; merge-back is diff-identical to full checkouts; loop.worktree_sparse (default true) round-trips through the four wiring points (dataclass _meta, load, to_dict, _EDITABLE_CONFIG+FE); existing worktree tests plus a fan-out timing assertion pass (SC 1, 2, 7).
